profile.headline: SMTS Graphics Software Engineer at AMD
profile.summary: An experienced and results-driven engineering leader with a comprehensive background in GPU architecture, C++ development and project management as well as extensive experience in IEEE 754 and 3D graphics apps, GLSL and drivers.

positions.title: SMTS Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description: As a C-model Team Lead for the AMD Workgroup Processor (WGP) block, I have deep technical expertise with strong leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills. I am responsible for guiding a team that develops and maintains a C++ simulation model that accurately simulates the WGP's behavior, including its interaction with the Instruction Set Architecture (ISA).
positions.insights: Anthropic Claude, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and +1 skill

positions.title: Senior Graphics Software Engineer
positions.description:
Product Owner of the Execution Unit team and the Framework team whilst driving and implementing mega-features that impacts multiple scrum teams.
Working on pre-silicon simulation model using C++14, to validate architectural design and HW implementation. 
•	Framework team has successfully improved simulator efficiency by creating various building blocks and guidelines to standardize how modules should be implemented
    o	The same code can be used in timed and untimed modes
•	EU modules continue to be used by RTL teams for functional validation
•	Improved on test coverage to eliminate more EU bugs before they reach the customer
•	Coordinate with other teams for synchronized merging of mega-feature functionality without breaking existing regression tests

positions.title: Graphics Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Graphics and Core driver validation on a variety of projects for next generation GPU IP. Validation of kernel drivers was done on pre-silicon and post silicon configurations and Linux and Android devices.
•	Analyze new features, test planning and test implementation
•	Successfully identified and resolved driver bugs before they were found by customers

positions.title: Graphics Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Core/Kernel driver validation team manager for embedded graphics on Android and Linux.

This is the validation of the Direct Render Manager (DRM) to ensure that the driver is functional and working at a certain level of performance. The team delivers continuous improvements to the igt-gpu-tools test suite and the open source Linux drivers.

I was also a Project Manager of the Linux driver/validation tasks for multiple Gens.

positions.title: Principal Engineer - Zii Advanced Products
positions.description:
Android Camera Subsystem

▪ Designed a camera effects pipeline for various image effects that supported a mixture of software, OpenCL and hardware accelerated implementations for the ZMS-05, ZMS-08 and ZMS-20 processors.
▪ Worked with camera vendor FAE on various camera models and extend the functionality of our camera driver and middleware. Extra features include: touch Focus and touch AWB, Flash and HDR.
▪ Designed and implemented automated tests to verify camera connectivity for mass production. 


Self calibrating wireless surround speakers

Lead the software teams from multiple departments as well as driving and designing the software architecture. Continued efforts to maintaining effective communication to ensure project milestones were achieved. Other responsibilities included:
▪ Defined deliverables and timescales for each team. Defined methods for each team to validate their components before they were delivered to other teams.
▪ Designed the software architecture to support the auto calibration system and the buffering mechanism needed for audio playback
▪ Ensured that all stakeholders were up to date on progress, risks and issues, etc - whilst managing my team and frequent communication with other team managers.


iRoar + iRock Smart Speaker System

▪ Designed and documented methods for measuring potential microphones' suitability for the iRoar's beamforming technology.
▪ Added support in the multi-channel audio processing pipeline for SB-Axx1™ DSP so that it could deliver a bass audio stream to the iRock subwoofer.


ZMS Parallel Processor

Designed and implemented a parallel processing architecture similar to the "Ziilabs ZMS-05 Teraflop Accelerator". Created a dynamic processor management systems to work with a standardized message-passing system to enable use of multiple ZMS chips to share the work of CPU intensive workloads.

The work from this project eventually lead to a design patent for a host device to access data from a docked device (below).

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Programming and testing C++ simulations to model the behaviour of a hardware design for 3D graphics chips.  The development of the C++ simulation was done mainly on a Unix/Linux platform.  Other scripting languages used to create computer generated header files include Perl and Awk.
•	Successfully achieve production quality silicon on the first tape-out
•	Implement individual units and link them together to form the graphics pipeline
•	Create and maintain an API framework to generate functional test content
•	Work with Validation team to verify that individual modules match RTL behavior

patents.title: Dock for a portable hard disk and a method for accessing content on a host device using the dock
